variantLabel.value: Variant 2 of 2: signature-normalised keys with defaults

statement.value: FunctionCallCache(capacity, signatures) starts empty. signatures maps each function name to its parameter list; a parameter is [name] (required) or [name, default]; required parameters come first. call(functionName, args, kwargs) binds the positional args to the first parameters in order, the keyword arguments by name and every unbound parameter to its default; every call is valid for its signature. Two calls are the same when their names are equal and every parameter is bound to the same value, so f(1), f(a=1) and f(1, b=0) coincide when b defaults to 0. Argument values are JSON values: null, booleans, integers, strings, lists and objects with string keys. Two values are the same when they have the same type and equal contents: true differs from 1, 1 differs from "1", lists compare in order, objects compare as key sets with equal values regardless of key order. Hits, misses, recency and eviction behave as an LRU cache with capacity entries; call returns true on a hit and false on a miss. Every method call is answered in call order on one instance; void methods return nothing.
